MIXING HINTS
1. Use good ingredients.
2. Use correct glassware.
3. Glassware should be clean and dry.
4. Shake drinks vigorously and serve cold.
5. Ice should not be used the second time.
6. Superfine sugar makes a drink clearer.
7. Follow authentic recipes as given.
    A jigger is a unit of measure, 1^ ounces;
        a Pony, % ounce.
9. A dash is equal to about 20 drops or one-
        quarter teaspoon.
10. Mixed drinks should not stand too long.
